analysis.overall: A calm afternoon gave way to a tricky night after a pump battery issue caused glucose to peak near 300 mg/dL, though you managed to bring it back down nicely by morning.

events.title: Overnight spike & pump disconnect
events.description: Glucose steadily climbed to a peak of 297 mg/dL while the pump was unreachable. Trends reversed quickly once the battery was replaced at 2:12 AM.

events.title: Early morning low
events.description: Glucose drifted down to 60 mg/dL before breakfast, prompting a temporary higher target to help stabilize.

events.title: Post-breakfast dip
events.description: The 5.3u bolus for 60g of carbs outpaced the food, pulling glucose back down to 60 mg/dL by 10:17 AM.

events.title: Midday stabilization
events.description: Glucose gradually recovered from the morning low and held comfortably steady in the 90–120 mg/dL range.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Check pump battery level and connection status before bed to prevent overnight delivery disruptions.
